headline: Explore the globe in field recordings
summary: Earth Garden offers a globe for exploring real-world field recordings. Experience unique soundscapes for work, sleep, or active listening. Discover the nuances of burbling brooks or urban chaos.

headline: iPhone Handoff will seamlessly share one number between two phones
summary: iOS 27 introduces iPhone Handoff for seamless phone switching. Use a single phone number across two different iPhones. A new demo clip shows how to set up this anticipated feature.

headline: CD sales are booming as physical media continues its resurgence
summary: CD sales surged by 45.7% in the first half of 2026. 17.5 million CDs were sold, up from 12 million last year. Physical media is experiencing a significant resurgence.

headline: Fantasy Footballers’ Andy Holloway is a dedicated zero-inbox kinda guy
summary: Andy Holloway co-hosts the acclaimed Fantasy Footballers podcast. The show boasts over 2 million monthly listeners and multiple awards. Holloway maintains a strict 'zero-inbox' email management philosophy.

headline: Zach Cregger Says He's Done With Franchise Films After Resident Evil
summary: Director Zach Cregger will not helm another franchise film. His survival horror adaptation of Resident Evil is set for premiere. This marks his final venture into established movie series.

headline: Primetime Review
summary: The Robert Pattinson film 'Primetime' receives a new review. It's described as a blast from the past with a sickly allure. The movie's style mirrors Chris Hansen’s 'To Catch a Predator'.

headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker Passes 1 Million Copies Sold in Just 2 Days
summary: New single-player RPG 'The Blood of Dawnwalker' sold 1 million copies. This sales milestone was reached in just two days post-launch. Bandai Namco and Rebel Wolves announced the rapid success.

headline: The Batman Part 2 Set Photos Hint at Arkham-Style Batsuit Upgrade
summary: New set photos reveal an updated Batsuit for 'The Batman Part II'. Robert Pattinson's suit draws comparisons to the iconic Arkham game design. Fans anticipate a more armored, game-inspired look.

headline: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for Ukraine talks
summary: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Vladimir Putin. Talks were held in Moscow concerning the Ukraine situation. Putin acknowledged the current situation as 'not so easy'.

headline: Disruption at Port of Dover as masked 'stop the boats' protesters block roads
summary: Masked 'stop the boats' protesters blocked roads at Port of Dover. The protest caused hours-long disruption at the port. The government condemned the behavior of the demonstrators.

headline: Nigel Farage tells BBC he 'wasn't listening' during foreign donor talks filmed undercover
summary: Nigel Farage claims he 'wasn't listening' during foreign donor talks. These talks were reportedly filmed undercover by the BBC. His family is 'begging' him to leave his job, he stated.

headline: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
summary: US launched attacks on three Iranian oil tankers. This action follows claims that US warships were targeted. Iran's state media reported retaliatory strikes, but the US is yet to comment.
